entities.summary: Salim Idris is a Syrian military officer and former rebel leader during the Syrian Civil War. He served as the minister of defense of the Syrian Interim Government and chief of staff of the Supreme Military Council (SMC) of the Syrian National Army, a Syrian rebel faction.
